description: Stationnement Vélo (CAPA) is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CAPA-Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. Ces données permettent de localiser et caractériser les stationnements vélos (arceaux) réalisés ou en projets sur le territoire de la CAPA. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are arceaux, déplacement, parking, vélo. The portal shows 40 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
